visualCharacteristics.purpose: bordered program cards with title, icon, short description and a Learn more button, four across

contentPattern.structure: one row per card; content in order: heading, icon image, description paragraph, link (Learn more) on its own line

usage: Homepage programs row (Assurance Program, Partner Program, Training, Certification).
reuseGuidance: Use for promo/feature cards with a call to action. The last link-only paragraph becomes the card footer CTA.
